title: S4 structured transition Mirror views
hypothesis: For stable S4-style diagonal-plus-low-rank dynamics, shared structured parameters plus per-role Mirror coordinates match independent structured transitions at <=60% actual payload bytes with stable extrapolations.
mirror_coordinate: per-role 2D Givens coordinate acting on shared low-rank factors

task.structure: stable negative diagonal plus rank-one correction
task.teacher: one shared S4-style transition conjugated by role-specific known 2D Givens rotations in a fixed state subspace

development.selection_metric: mean validation trajectory NRMSE at length 32

success_gate: On every fresh world, Mirror length-64 trajectory NRMSE <=1.10x independent; actual serialized bytes <=60% independent; all transitions stable; MAC proxy <=1.25x independent.
failure_gate: Any fresh world misses the quality or byte gate, any transition is unstable, or a simpler gate/residual control matches at lower actual bytes.
boundaries: Synthetic teacher is aligned to Givens rotations of the low-rank factor subspace.
No S4 FFT implementation or language-model quality claim.
Small state dimension; compute is a proxy plus CPU rollout timing.
